slides.headline: Book 2 hours. Keep the afternoon.
slides.body: After 2 hours, we stop the clock. Here's how we'd spend it.

slides.headline: Cliffs, dunes, lunch, home.
slides.body: Cave Point, Whitefish Dunes and lunch near Glidden Drive. About 17 miles round trip.

slides.img: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Ice castles ebike tour photos/Door-County-ebike-garage.jpg
slides.headline: Grab a bike in Jacksonport.
slides.body: Fat tires, pedal assist and the 2-hour rental. That's the whole plan.

slides.headline: Tree-covered backroads.
slides.body: Lake Shore Road, then Cave Point Drive under the trees. The motor does the hills.

slides.headline: Cave Point on a windy day.
slides.body: Waves slam the ledges and throw spray. Watch from the top and stay off wet rock.

slides.img: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/Whitefish-Bay-Dunes-State-Park-E-Bike-Tour-Rental.jpg
slides.headline: Whitefish Dunes.
slides.body: Park the bike, walk the boardwalk to the beach. Bikes stay on bike routes in the park.

slides.headline: 1.5 miles of sandy beach.
slides.body: Fall means far fewer people. No lifeguards, so skip the swim.

slides.headline: Lunch where Glidden Drive starts.
slides.body: @thehitchingpostbar on Glidden Drive posts weekend hours noon to 8. Call ahead in late fall: 920-818-1114.

slides.headline: Same way back. No clock.
slides.body: Ride a stretch of Glidden Drive, a Wisconsin Rustic Road, then retrace your route. Be back before dark.

slides.kicker: Save this for a fall weekend
slides.headline: 2 hours booked. Afternoon free.
slides.body: Book the 2-hour e-bike rental. The extra time this fall is on us.
